messages.content: Compile the supplied local source provision into the supplied declarative aggregation plan. Select its scope keys, numeric limit, order of cap application and eligibility operation yourself from the source and relation meanings. each_payment caps each eligible row before summation; after_group_total groups by the chosen keys, sums each group and caps the group total, then sums the results; once_after_all_payments caps the final total. exists admits each payment if it has any witness; join retains joined witness multiplicity; ignore includes every payment. Use a nonempty exact governing source substring as source_quote. Return only the schema; no hardcoded people, events or case answers.
